system.description:
Trained in the Dul Khagul dwarven tradition of siege warfare — breaking lines, shattering formations, holding ground.

  • Siege Master: Advantage on Strength checks to break, smash, or force open objects. Whirlwind Attack's Level limit rises from half the Barbarian's level to two-thirds of it.
  • Dwarf-Bound: Advantage on dwarven clan etiquette and Dul Khagul military structure checks. Recognised as a warrior of note on sight by Dul Khagul soldiers.
